To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

in Ad2+ ND4-infected cells, the expression of the genetic information of both Ad2 and SV4O is controlled by Ad2 genetic information and that this control is exerted at the level of transcription of the viral genes.

in Ad2+ ND4 infection transcription is initiated in a portion of Ad2 DNA and continues into the SV40 DNA, and that this transcription of SV40 genetic information is under Ad2, not SV40, genetic control.
the expression of SV40 T-antigen in Ad2-SV4O hybrid viruses is under Ad2 control, and that transcription of the SV40 information is initiated in Ad2 DNA.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new type of hybrid virus which has the potential of combining the properties of two different viruses.
the molecular mechanisms by which eukaryotic cells control the expression of their own and foreign genetic information.
the mechanism of transcriptional control of the expression of the genetic information of the simian virus 4o (SV40).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

Ad2 and SV4O T antigens are expressed in the Ad2+ND 4 hybrid virus by transcriptional initiation at Ad2 sequences and that the transcriptional control of the expression of SV40 T-antigen is under Ad2 control in this hybrid virus.
the expression of the simian virus 4o (SV4o) genetic information is under the genetic control of the adenovirus 5 (Ad5) in the Ad5-SV4o hybrid virus.

the interferon sensitivity or resistance of SV40 T-antigen synthesis in cells infected with Ad2, Ad2+ ND4, or SV40, respectively, reflects the transcriptional control of SV40 T -antigen synthesis by Ad2 DNA.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
in Ad2+ ND4 infection, the expression of at lest one portion of the SV 40 genetic information is controlled by Ad2 genetic information.
the Ad2 DNA is transcribed by the SV40 RNA polymerase, and the resulting RNA is spliced to form a hybrid RNA molecule which is then translated to yield SV40 T antigen.
the expression of the SV40 genes in Ad2+Nd4 is under Ad 2 genetic control and that the SV40-specific sequences of the hybrid RNA are linked to the Ad2-specific sequences of the same molecule.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have shown that adenovirus can control the expression of the SV40 T-antigen gene.
the Ad2+ND-4 genome is not a simple concatenation of SV40 and Ad-2 DNA. Rather
the expression of SV40 genetic information is under Ad2 control in Ad2+ ND4.
